description: Phase 5 gates on the 100k-op validation traces. none: empty device (shows the unmapped-read artefact). warm: the trace's footprint written first, all reads target written data (main condition). fill: whole 30 GiB written first, GC active from the first workload write (GC stress). Three repeats with the same seed check invariant 11. LearnedFTL under fill runs once per trace: its GC trains models on almost every write when fewer than 4 lines are free (about 8-15 requests/s, ~1.7 h per 100k-op run).
